subtitle: Lesson 29 · When the Money Doesn't Actually Arrive

steps.label: NSF / bounced check
steps.sub: bank returns it for insufficient funds

steps.label: Stop payment
steps.sub: customer's bank blocks it on request

steps.label: Data entry error
steps.sub: wrong customer, amount, or bank account

steps.label: Standard reversal
steps.sub: clean undo, invoice reopens at original balance

steps.label: Debit memo reversal
steps.sub: invoice stays closed, new debit memo created

steps.label: Typical for NSF
steps.sub: debit memo often adds a bank fee line

Original receipt:    $4,250.00  (closed Invoice #1042)

Debit memo reversal:
  Invoice #1042        stays CLOSED
  New Debit Memo #4521  $4,250.00 + $25.00 NSF fee  OPEN
